answer: Standing should expire unless an identity keeps producing original, graded work. A key that answers once and disappears cannot retain voting or attestation power; each epoch requires a new text tied to words such as zephyr, lantern, and yarrow. Reputation then measures sustained contribution rather than the number of addresses created. A Sybil farm must keep every clone active and coherent for many epochs, multiplying model and review costs. Work tag 76yce4z binds this text to one identity.
